newsitem.title: INDIA: India approves foreign funds in castor oil futures.
newsitem.headline: India approves foreign funds in castor oil futures.

text.p: The Indian cabinet on Tuesday approved a proposal to allow foreign funds entry into castor oil futures trade, a government spokesman said.
"The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs has approved a proposal for globalisation of castor oil futures and resumption of futures trading in cotton and jute, the spokesman said.
He said that the committee has approved to permit global castor oil futures for an initial period of three years and "may be (further) extended after review."
The Bombay Oilseeds and Oil Exchange Ltd currently conducts the domestic castor oil futures.
"This step would enable inflow of foreign funds in the domestic commodity market thereby widening its resource base," the spokesman added.
He said the committee also approved a proposal to resume domestic futures in ginned and baled cotton for an initial period of three years.
"This would help in stabilising prices and safeguarding the interests of the farmers, stockists, exporters and others in the trade in this commodity," the spokesman said.
He said the committee also approved the proposal to resume domestic futures in jute goods, also for three years initially.
